verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Ask AI answers natural-language questions across the inbox without the user needing to recall senders or keywords (e.g. "where is the q2 offsite", "when is my flight"). Its official MCP server also connects inbox and calendar to Claude or ChatGPT for cross-inbox and calendar queries, thread summaries and follow-up tracking. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers are grounded with source citations, documented calendar or "what's outstanding" queries in the native Ask AI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
